name: Venn
options: BCH or one token, held at a separate money address
votes: locked, majority or everyone per category
recovery with stop rules A, B or C
weaknesses: Fixed-period budgets carry unused budget over.
Whoever controls enough votes can move everything.
With 'everyone', one lost key freezes that kind of change unless recovery replaces it.
A recovery request freezes the card until it completes or is stopped; that member cannot vote meanwhile.
Enough helpers working together can take over a card after the wait.
The contract cannot tell people apart: a vote that may add members can add someone's second key.

name: Circle
options: one token, the same contribution from every member each round
pays out when everyone has paid, or after the round's deadline
weaknesses: The contract cannot make anyone pay. A member who stops paying after their turn keeps what they received.
After a deadline anyone can pay out the round, so late contributions miss that round.
Money left at the Circle after the last round goes to the last member in the order, whoever sent it.
